body: Reported with a screenshot. The only code that auto-binds is the openerTabId inheritance in background/index.ts, which exists so a target=_blank link from an app does not fall out of its session. A Cmd+T tab has an opener too, so it inherits. FIX: inherit only when the new tab's pendingUrl/url is http(s) AND its host is in the parent session's domain set or equals its site; never for chrome://, about:, the new-tab page, or a tab with no URL yet. Violates the project's own rule that an unbound tab must behave exactly like an ordinary tab. Spec section 7.1.
title: BUG: a blank Cmd+T tab joins a persona
